plan.objective: Test validation-selected regularization, a fixed nonlinear probe, and validation-selected late fusion without altering frozen representations or variant support.
plan.partition: All five existing manuscript chromosome folds, three seeds, strict and one-hop; original test and validation chromosomes also excluded from graph encoder training
plan.unit: Original variant row; repeated positions with different alleles remain together by chromosome. Preserve all original match groups, each containing one positive and nine negatives on one chromosome.
plan.encoder: Existing v1 frozen checkpoint for each fold/seed/context; no new pretraining, tuning or checkpoint selection on TraitGym
plan.sequence: Unmodified manuscript segment-level NT-v2 50M cache; not reference-minus-alternate embeddings
plan.mapping: Previously audited GRCh38 [pos-1,pos) containing reference segment; no nearest fallback and no row exclusions
plan.probe: Native standardized balanced logistic probe with validation-only C selection; fixed-budget shallow histogram gradient boosting; convex probability blend selected on validation chromosomes. No refit or hyperparameter choice on test.
plan.primary: Exploratory changes versus fixed manuscript probe; incremental T evaluated within each predeclared probe family and with H controls.
controls: V-only endpoint retained in all fusion comparisons
Identical original variants, checkpoints, chromosome splits and frozen feature arrays
plan.inference: Existing hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap with 10000 draws; paired exact fold sign-flip and BH correction over all dataset/context/contrast comparisons within each metric. Overlapping training folds limit independence.
validity_gates: Exact C=1 replay against prior completed scores
All linear candidates converge; HGB completes its fixed budget; all predictions finite
Saved validation selection and prediction replay
No test-driven choice among reported arms
plan.interpretation: Exploratory follow-up on previously inspected TraitGym variants, using all five manuscript chromosome folds and all seeds/contexts. Improvement of a downstream classifier does not establish better encoder weights. V is an author-provided NT-2.5B allele score; S remains frozen NT-v2 50M. HGB is a fixed 150-tree-budget estimator without a convergence criterion; only logistic probes can be called converged. No official leaderboard equivalence.
plan.development_status: Exploratory study motivated by previously inspected test results. All grids and model arms pinned before fitting; this is not new independent confirmation or a basis for best-model claims.
plan.variant_score_definition: V contains signed LLR and its absolute value, fixed before fitting. The original author NT-2.5B masked-allele score averages forward and reverse sequences; this is not its full embedding-based benchmark.
plan.score_provenance: Exact published score files pinned by dataset revision and LFS SHA-256. Source rule reads original test.parquet and writes predictions in source order. Files have positional indices, not genomic IDs; alignment relies on this published contract. Model-weight revision and exact original runtime are not recorded by the author code.
plan.selection_rule: Max validation raw-probability AUPRC; exact ties prefer smaller C or larger V mixture weight. Calibration and classification threshold use validation only.
plan.numerical_policy: Promote native probabilities to float64 before any convex blend. Native values are preserved exactly; mixture, validation replay and calibration use explicit double precision.

calibration_replay: Saved temperatures/probabilities and thresholds replay; validation NLL is within 1e-12 of an independent local refit. Temperature refit drift is recorded separately.
interpretation: Exploratory pointwise fold/seed intervals; seed repetitions are not independent biological samples. No performance-based subset selection.
